<thought>
The cell directly in front of me is a lava cell (L), which is dangerous and should be avoided. To reach the goal (G), which is visible up and to the right, I need to head right rather than forward. I should turn right to face the open path.
</thought>
<action>
TURN_RIGHT
</action>

<thought>
Now I am facing right. In front of me is a wall (#), so moving forward is not possible. To continue toward the goal (G), which is up and to the left in my view, I should turn left to face upward, where an open path is available.
</thought>
<action>
TURN_LEFT
</action>

<thought>
I am now facing upward again. The cell immediately in front of me is an empty floor (.), which is safe to move into. Advancing forward keeps me progressing toward the goal, which is still ahead and to the right.
</thought>
<action>
MOVE_FORWARD
</action>
